paragraphs: In [Bava Metzia 80b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.80b.13), he raised an objection to Rafram bar Papa.

Hyman calls him very pious. In [Chullin 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.60b.5-6), he planted his garden, but nothing grew. He prayed for mercy, rain came, and it sprouted. He said, “This illustrates Rav Assi’s teaching.”[^1]

notes.text: The preceding passage has Rav Assi explain that the plants did not sprout until Adam prayed for rain. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2691&lang=en) cites the garden account and the Bava Metzia discussion.
